{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 3) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE:- 1)TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-30 HRc."}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies a hardness range of 24-32 HRC while note N3 specifies 28-30 HRc, giving the heat treater two conflicting requirements. The designer should delete one note or align both to a single hardness range."
    ,
    "recommended_correction": "Remove the duplicate heat treatment instruction and state one consistent hardness range in a single note."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 3) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block field 'heat_treatment' is marked '---' (indicating none), yet note N1 explicitly requires toughening to 24-32 HRC. This contradiction can cause the part to be manufactured without the required heat treatment. The designer should update the title block heat treatment field to reflect the requirement stated in N1."
    ,
    "recommended_correction": "Update the title block heat_treatment field to match the heat treatment specified in note N1."}]}
